title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 111. Stresses that the GST highlights the importance of transitioning to sustainable lifestyles and sustainable patterns of consumption and production, which must align with human rights and social equity rather than being imposed through top-down restrictions that compromise personal freedoms or basic needs; stresses the need to improve the EU’s circular economy without compromising Europe’s competitiveness;
